20766: Tatsumi Oga is the main protagonist in the Beelzebub series, first introduced as a strong fighter, beating up some fellow class mates and then making them bow down to him because they had attacked him in his sleep.
20769: Furuichi is one of the main protagonists of Beelzebub. Furuichi is Oga's best friend and along with him is a 1st year at Ishiyama High. After finding out about Oga's baby he joins him up in his search for a new parent.
21153: Hilda, is a Demon that serves as both the adoptive mother and wet nurse to Beelzebub IV. She is an attractive young woman with blonde hair that covers one side of her face and is tied in a bun, green eyes and a well-endowed chest.
21154: The son of the Devil King. He is very attached to Oga, clinging with a vice-like grip to Oga's back. When he is agitated or sees blood, he will spontaneously electrocute anyone within his vicinity. Beelzebub's characteristic cry is "Daabuu!
21155: Alaindelon surprisingly resembles Queen lead singer Freddy Mercury. They share hairstyles, moustache and even attitude. However, Alaindelon is better built being quite muscular. He often wears sweatshirts along with boxer shorts. Alaindelon is a very comical person.

23247: The fourth Touhoushinki member. He is by far the strongest member of the Touhoushinki (his strength in comparison to Kunieda is not confirmed, though it can be implied that he is stronger than her indirectly from their other fights).

23249: He is the son of the "Himekawa Group", a financial zaibatsu, and the second member of the Tohoshinki.
23278: Aoi's baby brother, who is often mistaken for her own child. He is considered to be Beelzebub IV's sworn enemy (only by Beelzebub though).
25401: Originally Kunieda Aoi's second-in-command, Nene is far more aggressive than her permissive leader.
25402: A long-haired underling of Toujou's. He has a calm attitude and is shown to be bookish, but is nevertheless a strong fighter.
25403: Toujou's right-hand man. He wears sunglasses and has a cool attitude, and is a strong fighter. He has been able to evade one of Oga's attacks and even fight him briefly, although Oga had been taken by surprise.
25404: A first-year and leading member of the Red Tails. Chiaki rarely speaks and dispatches her enemies swiftly with a pair of modified air-guns hidden under her skirt (actually, she can use up to four guns at the same time).

25656: A former imperial doctor to the royal family. He has the appearance of a tall, dark-haired man, but in the human world he takes up a provisional body due to his contempt of humans.

31320: He is a good-looking junior at Saint Ishiyama High with light wavy hair. His behavior changes based on the situation. He has shown a distinct animosity towards Oga for his ruthless persona and has openly commented on his flaws in battle.
32027: Sakaki is a member of the Saint Ishiyama Club Captain's Alliance and captain of the kendo club. He is a Junior like his comrade Shinjou. He is indifferent in battle and in conversation and rarely speaks even to back up one of his fellow knights.
32092: Azusa is a student at St. Ishiyama Academy and is Kazu's childhood friend. She is also an airhead, a good friend with Aoi, and she likes cute things.
33076: The leader of the six knights. A senior at St. Ishiyama High. Miki's teacher and the 16th head of the Izuma style martial arts. The leader of the six knights. He is shown to be the strongest of its members holding a great deal of authority over the group.
33077: She is an attractive senior and the only female memeber of the six knights. Her hair colour is unknown and her fighting style is undetermined aswell.
39519: Sachura is one of En's three Maid Demons, often seen serving En Calpis soda on ice. She wears her long red hair in two braids and appears to be the youngest of the nurses.
39520: Izabella leads the three nurses and has a cold, serious attitude. She wears glasses and carries a book of incantations that she uses to cater for Lord En's needs and whims.
39521: She bears a strong resemblance to Hilda and carries a mop with her, which she uses as a weapon much as Hilda uses her parasol. The two seem to have an unsettled score and Yolda positively despises Hilda.

39883: Abe, otherwise known as Killer Machine Abe (キラーマシーン阿部, Kirā Mashīn Abe), is a second year student at Ishiyama High School. He is seen always wearing a orange seat-shirt and have multiple scars on his face. Also seen wearing a black necklace around his neck.
39884: Oga's older sister and the first leader of the Red Tails. A young adult now, she is nevertheless still violent and scares even Oga and Furuichi, but seems to get along with Hilda very well.
39885: Oga's father. The master of the "sliding grovel."

40110: He is a member of the MK5.

40116: Angelica is a transdimensional demon and is the daughter of Alaindelon.
40118: Galle is from the demon world.

40417: Ryouko is a member of the Red Tails. She wears a mask over her mouth. A very good fighter. She and the Red Tails intervene to stop the whole male student body of Ishiyama from attacking Oga.
42866: Naga is one of the Pillar heads in Behemoth's 34 Pillar Division, He is a cold person that don't show any signs of anger a lot, Nonetheless, he worries about his companions, especially with his master En. (taken from Beelzebub.Wikia.com)

56091: He is a commentator of the volleyball match between the Rokkisei and Ishiyama High School.
56093: He is the principal of Saint Ishiyama Academy.
56173: The first homeroom teacher of the Ishiyama class at St. Ishiyama prior to Saotome's arrival.
